about.text: A soft, sweet, light golden-brown spread from Norway, called mysmør or prim. It is made by boiling down whey with cream, like brunost, but it is sweetened with sugar and left spreadable instead of being pressed into a block. It tastes of mild caramel.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Pushed further, it becomes mesost (whey cheese)
